data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (converter, then holidays, then an email to ops@example.com with the same subject and body templates) and names the right four parameters. It is weaker in three places: it says "Send or discard" where the true workflow requires Discard, it hardcodes "ahead" and two holiday dates, and it doesn't say to switch to the Mail tab, though that is minor.
